description: This file defines an abstract generic class for serializing enum types with a 32-bit base, along with specific serializers for DateTimeKind and DayOfWeek enums. It includes methods for writing and reading enum values to and from a binary format, utilizing unsafe code for performance.

classes.name: Enum32BaseCodec
classes.description: Abstract generic class providing serialization logic for 32-bit enum types.

classes.name: DateTimeKindCodec
classes.description: Serializer and copier for DateTimeKind enum, inherits from Enum32BaseCodec.

classes.name: DayOfWeekCodec
classes.description: Serializer and copier for DayOfWeek enum, inherits from Enum32BaseCodec.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an enum value to a binary writer, converting it to an int32.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes an int32 from a binary reader and converts it back to the enum type.
